rules.description: Total assets equal total equity and liabilities (general statement layout). Generalises pipeline/validate/check_reconciliations.py.
Total assets equal total liabilities plus net assets (banking statement layout).

Operating, investing, and financing cash flows sum to the net change in cash and cash equivalents. Outflows are stored as negative amounts. Generalises the first check in pipeline/validate/check_cash_flows.py.
Opening cash plus the net change, exchange-rate effects, and cash acquired through a merger equals closing cash. Generalises the second check in pipeline/validate/check_cash_flows.py.

components.assumption_when_absent: No merger-cash fact was recorded for this period, so it is taken as nil. Filings show this reconciling line only when a merger occurred (FFC FY2025 shows a dash). Confirm against the source before relying on the result.

rules.description: Net sales plus cost of sales (stored negative) equal gross profit.
Mark-up/return/interest earned plus mark-up/return/interest expensed (stored negative) equal net mark-up/interest income (banking layout).
